verdict.rationale: Honeycomb Triggers and SLO burn alerts let users define threshold-based rules on events, and these can route to Slack, PagerDuty, Teams, or custom webhooks with templated JSON payloads to drive downstream automation. This covers rule-based alerting well but the evidence only shows notification/webhook dispatch, not built-in execution of arbitrary remediation actions. Missing for 10: evidence of native automated remediation/action execution (not just notification routing), and independent/hands-on confirmation of end-to-end automation reliability.
